svg.title: Plasma projector: a compact receiver and projecting slotted head
svg.desc: One SVG weapon proposal, enlarged dark and energised, and mounted beneath the left wing of the current Wasp. A blue and pale cyan receiver holds a stepped dark head. Two long open recesses hold pale gold energy below solid metal edges. Paired small relief mouths are built into the forward shoulders.
svg.text: Current left slot · under hull · 10 image px/u
1 image px/u at native sheet width
One assembly · same geometry at every size
SVG proposal · physical form and restrained internal light · no firing effects or production implementation
